label: PfiAT system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Pf4 prophage-encoded PfiAT toxin-antitoxin locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model requiring PfiAT__PfiA and PfiAT__PfiT.
observations: PfiAT branch under phage defense system; distinct from the individual PfiA antitoxin, the individual PfiT toxin, generic ParE/Phd-family type II toxin-antitoxin systems, the PfiAT__PfiA and PfiAT__PfiT HMM profiles, Pf4 prophage production regulation, Pf4r-mediated immunity, source database rows naming one PfiAT model, and other phage-defense systems.
